mat-6-28.label: When you’re worried about having enough
mat-6-28.emph: Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow.
mat-6-28.cta: Save this for a morning when nothing feels like enough.

scene.label: the scene
scene.body: A hillside in Galilee. Jesus sits down and talks to a crowd about what they worry about most: what to eat, what to wear. Then he points to the wildflowers in the fields.
scene.credit: Carl Bloch, The Sermon on the Mount, 1877
scene.alt: Painting: Jesus seated on a rock on a hillside, teaching a crowd of men and women gathered around him.

today.body: The flowers don’t weave or sew a thing, and still they’re clothed. Noticing that doesn’t mean ignoring your worries. It means seeing that care is already at work.
today.extra: Save this for a morning when nothing feels like enough.

pro-10-25.label: When everything feels shaky
pro-10-25.emph: but the righteous stand firm forever.
pro-10-25.hook: Storms don’t decide what’s solid. They just show it.
pro-10-25.cta: Save this for a shaky week.

scene.label: the picture
scene.body: Proverbs is a book of short sayings about everyday life. In ancient Israel, storm winds could hit without warning. Afterward, you could see what had been built to last.
scene.credit: Illustration by WithGod, made with AI
scene.alt: Illustration: a small stone house on a rocky hill after a storm, dark clouds moving away and sunlight breaking through.

today.body: A storm doesn’t decide what is solid. It only shows it. When a small choice comes up today, ask whether it could stand up to any wind.
today.extra: Save this for a shaky week.
